{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below current prices, showing significant lag that narrows as forecasts extend further into the future",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price levels but shows delayed reaction - high sentiment (1.00) aligns with price plateaus while low sentiment (-0.33 to 0.00) precedes or accompanies price declines",
    "One-week-ahead forecasts overshoot true outcomes by approximately 1-2 euros, correcting as the forecast horizon extends to 10-15 days",
    "Price mean-reversion is evident in true outcomes but model forecasts fail to capture the slow decay from current levels, especially in volatile segments",
    "Sentiment turning negative (0.00 to -0.33) reliably precedes the 2-3 euro price declines visible in the first 10 days of true outcomes",
    "Model under-predicts price peaks by 1-3 euros relative to true maximums, suggesting the forecasting model lacks capacity to capture short-term volatility momentum",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes widens from ~1 euro at day 1 to ~3-4 euros by day 15-20, indicating forecast accuracy degrades significantly for longer horizons"
] }
